description: This file defines the SearchViewModel class for managing the search UI state in an Android application. It handles search queries, search results, recent searches, and related user interactions, integrating with various repositories and use cases. The class uses Kotlin coroutines and Flow to manage asynchronous data streams and is annotated with Hilt for dependency injection.

classes.name: SearchViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the search feature's UI state, including handling search queries, displaying results, managing recent searches, and logging analytics events.

methods.name: onSearchQueryChanged
methods.description: Updates the saved state handle with the new search query.

methods.name: onSearchTriggered
methods.description: Handles explicit search trigger events, such as user pressing the search button; saves the query and logs an analytics event.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears all recent search entries from the repository.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Marks a news resource as bookmarked or unbookmarked.

methods.name: followTopic
methods.description: Follows or unfollows a topic based on user action.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed or unviewed.
